record.title: Data Management user update endpoint allows a project or site Data Manager to overwrite coding languages and profile fields of users shared with other projects
record.description: In `app/routes/data_management.py`, `PUT /data-management/api/users/<target_user_id>` (`manage_update_user`, `lines 1083-1180`) and `POST /data-management/api/users/<target_user_id>/resend-verification` (`manage_resend_verification`, `lines 974-1000`) authorize mutations on `target_user` via `_dm_can_manage_user_profile(target_user)` (`lines 1045-1081`). Unlike the comparable roster profile-edit baseline `mobile_sign_in_service.may_edit_account` / `_roster_rule` (`app/services/mobile_sign_in_service.py:155-194`, `231-259`, enforced by `PATCH /admin/api/projects/<project_id>/people/<target_user_id>/profile` at `app/routes/admin_organization.py:1639-1640`), which requires that the target user hold no privileged grants, have every active grant within the caller's manageable scope, and have no `MapProjectMember` rows outside the caller's managed projects (`_outside_member`), `_dm_can_manage_user_profile` passes if: (1) `target_user.other.get('created_by_user_id') == str(current_user.user_id)` (`lines 1054-1056`) regardless of current grants in other projects; (2) the target user satisfies `_managed_user_condition()` (`lines 187-194`, `1057-1065`), an existential check requiring only at least one active grant in `_listed_grants_condition()`; or (3) the caller is a wide writer (`_is_wide_writer()`, `lines 179-184`) and the target user has zero active grants and is not in `mentors.member_user_ids` (`lines 1066-1080`), without checking `MapProjectMember` outside the caller's projects. Consequently, a Data Manager in Project A (either for an already-shared user or after unilaterally granting a Project B user a role in Project A via `POST /data-management/api/access-grants`) can overwrite `target_user.job_title` (`line 1119`) and `target_user.vacode_language` (`line 1164`), disrupting coding/review language filtering (`app/decorators/va_validate_permissions.py:187`, `app/services/coder_workflow_service.py:112`, `app/services/reviewer_coding_service.py:403`) for Project B.
record.claimed_root_cause: `app/routes/data_management.py:_dm_can_manage_user_profile` (`lines 1045-1081`) uses creator attribution (`lines 1054-1056`), an existential single-grant check `_managed_user_condition()` (`lines 187-194`, `1057-1065`), and an unplaced-user check omitting `_outside_member` (`lines 1066-1080`), instead of requiring that all active grants (with none privileged) and all `MapProjectMember` memberships of `target_user` fall within the caller's manageable scope.

trace.description: PUT /data-management/api/users/<target_user_id> accepts JSON payload with job_title and/or languages from a caller with role data_manager or admin.
Checks _dm_can_manage_user_profile(target_user) before allowing job_title or languages updates.
Authorizes profile mutation if target_user matches _managed_user_condition() (or was created by current_user at line 1055, or has no active grants when caller is a wide writer at lines 1066-1080).
Subquery requires only that target_user has at least one active grant matching _listed_grants_condition(), ignoring active grants or MapProjectMember rows in other projects.
Overwrites target_user.vacode_language (and target_user.job_title at line 1119) and commits at line 1168, altering global account state across all projects.

evidence.description: _dm_can_manage_user_profile allows mutation when created_by_user_id matches (line 1055), when at least one active grant is managed via _managed_user_condition() (lines 1057-1065), or when the user has no active grants and caller is a wide writer (lines 1066-1080).
_managed_user_condition checks VaUsers.user_id.in_(select(VaUserAccessGrants.user_id)...) for any single active grant in _listed_grants_condition().
manage_update_user mutates target_user.job_title (line 1119) and target_user.vacode_language (line 1164) and commits (line 1168).

Comparable baseline _roster_rule / editable_user_ids (lines 155-194, 231-259) requires every active grant of the target user to be managed by the actor (none privileged) and no MapProjectMember row outside the actor's managed projects (_outside_member).
Roster profile endpoint enforces mobile.may_edit_account(current_user, user.user_id, project_id) and rejects shared accounts with 403.

blockers: OS-enforced sandbox execution with no external network, empty allowlisted environment, read-only target/tools, and scratch-only writes is unavailable on this VM, preventing dynamic execution of the Flask test client to record an observed result.

validation_plan.local: Run pytest inside the approved isolated test container against a dedicated test database (e.g., TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://minerva:minerva@minerva_db_service:5432/minerva_test_verifier) with a test that creates User U holding an active coder grant in Project A (with vacode_language=['english', 'hindi']) and an active coder grant in Project B, authenticates as Project A's Data Manager (who has no grants in Project B), sends PUT /data-management/api/users/<U.user_id> with {'languages': ['english'], 'job_title': 'Changed'} and X-CSRFToken, and verifies whether 200 is returned and U.vacode_language is overwritten globally.
validation_plan.deployment: No deployment validation required; the authorization check is self-contained in Flask route logic and SQLAlchemy queries and can be fully validated in an isolated local test database.
